deadline = the last day or time something must be finished
flexible hours = a system where you can choose when to start and finish
nine-to-five = a traditional full-time office schedule
commute = to travel regularly between home and work
colleague = a person you work with
well-paid = giving a lot of money for the work
demanding = needing a lot of effort, skill or time
redundant = without a job because the company no longer needs that position
self-employed = working for yourself, not for an employer
run a business = to own and manage a company
career path = the series of jobs you take as you progress
part-time = working fewer hours than a full week
full-time = working the complete normal number of hours
temporary = lasting only for a limited period
permanent = intended to last, not for a short period
reference = a statement from a previous employer about your work
qualifications = exams, degrees or certificates that show your skills
work-life balance = a fair division of time between job and private life
